items.name: qumcl
items.bio:
qumcl (also stylized as クムクル) is an alias of Belarusian–Ukrainian experimental electronic musician, designer, and producer Egor Gerasenko (born March 4, 2003 in Pyt-Yakh) known also as Yahor Hierasienka-Dziejkun (Belarusian spelling). His music blends weirdcore, lo-fi textures, IDM, ambient, jungle, glitch, noise, and experimental electronics, often incorporating tape hiss, field recordings, and digital decay aesthetics.

In 2024, he co-founded the Xeuqra label together with British artist Xiroach. The label focuses on weirdcore, glitch, IDM, and experimental electronic music. Building on this, in 2026 he launched Q-REC, a sub-label under the Xeuqra umbrella, focusing on more specific or experimental artist projects.
items.aliases: qu12, Qulicker, sunymoia, クムクル, Madcap Laughs

items.name: Xiroach
items.bio: Xiroach is an electronic musician and producer based in England, United Kingdom. He is the co-founder, alongside Belarusian artist Egor Gerasenko, of the independent label Xeuqra, established in 2024.

items.name: Enrich 33E
items.bio: British electronic music project focusing on abstract soundscapes, ambient drone, glitch, and lo-fi field recordings

items.name: Fractured Voices
items.bio: Electronic music producers duo. The sound of Fractured Voices blends abstract glitch collages, drone, sound art, and continuous tape mixtapes accompanied by unsettling spoken word fragments. Lyrics often explore themes of madness, surveillance, identity loss, and concrete dreams of Soviet architecture.
